heading: Prohibition on bringing of qualified civil liability actions in Federal or State court

tree.heading: In general
tree.text: A qualified civil liability action may not be brought in any Federal or State court.

tree.heading: Dismissal of pending actions
tree.text: A qualified civil liability action that is pending on October 26, 2005, shall be immediately dismissed by the court in which the action was brought or is currently pending.
